title: Searching for BSM Experimental Signatures with Large Lagrangian Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.38309v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The search for physics Beyond the Standard Model (BSM) is generally limited not by the supply of theory descriptions but by the lack of discriminating experimental observations. A case in point is dark matter, where the overwhelming gravitational evidence only goes so far in distinguishing between models within a vast theory space. Exploring the space of testable model signatures may help identify overlooked experimental observables and indicate the utility of future experiments. A challenge is designing a search through model signatures outside what is found in the literature. Our primary contribution is hAIthem, a framework that combines the self-guided exploration of reinforcement learning (RL) with the broad literature-derived knowledge of LLMs. We build an RL agent that learns to find which portions of a theory's high-dimensional parameter space are not excluded under some subset of constraints by playing a Battleship-style "game"

translated_title: 基于大型拉格朗日模型搜索超出标准模型（BSM）的实验特征
translated_abstract: 对超出标准模型（BSM）物理的探索，通常并非受限于理论描述的匮乏，而是受限于缺乏具有区分能力的实验观测。暗物质便是一个典型例子：尽管引力证据确凿，但在广阔的理论空间中，这些证据在区分不同模型方面的作用仍然有限。探索可检验的模型特征空间，可能有助于发现被忽视的实验可观测量，并为未来实验的价值提供指引。一个挑战在于如何设计搜索方法，以探索文献之外的模型特征。我们的主要贡献是hAIthem——一个将强化学习（RL）的自引导探索与大语言模型（LLM）源自文献的广博知识相结合的框架。我们构建了一个强化学习智能体，它通过玩类似“海战棋”式的“游戏”，学会在给定约束条件的子集下，找出理论的高维参数空间中哪些区域尚未被排除。
tldr: 该论文提出了hAIthem框架，将强化学习的自主探索能力与大语言模型的文献知识相结合，通过“海战棋”式的游戏机制自动探索BSM理论的高维参数空间，以发现未被排除的理论区域和被忽视的实验特征。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces hAIthem, a framework combining self-guided reinforcement learning exploration with LLM-derived literature knowledge, which uses a Battleship-style game to automatically explore high-dimensional BSM parameter spaces and identify unexcluded regions and overlooked experimental signatures.
